# klaviyo_webhook (Data Source)

Look up an existing Klaviyo webhook by id. Note: `secret_key` is not exposed (Klaviyo never returns it on read), and `endpoint_url_prefix` is the truncated value Klaviyo returns for security.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Webhook id.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `endpoint_url_prefix` (String) Truncated endpoint URL (security feature; the full URL is not retrievable from Klaviyo).
- `name` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)
- `webhook_topics` (List of String)
